content:
Connor O'Brien: runtime-1.18-lts: RC is ready for 1.18.1-lts. Unless anyone sees a blocker, we can move to publish after final sign-offs.

Artifacts:
- runtime image: `registry.redwood.dev/runtime:1.18.1-lts-rc.1`
- runtime tag candidate: `runtime-1.18.1-lts` (NOT pushed yet)
- git tag candidate: `runtime-v1.18.1-lts` (NOT created yet)

Perf gates (summary + raw):
- perf-canary run: https://github.com/redwood/perf-canary/actions/runs/104882331
- gate summary artifact: https://github.com/redwood/perf-canary/suites/284120331/artifacts/ltspatch-1.18.1-rc1-summary

Release PR (notes + tags): https://github.com/redwood/redwood/pull/23510

Asks:
- Runtime: kernel/scheduler sign-off
- SRE: rollout/monitoring sign-off
- Build: provenance/checksums present + signed

Reply with :white_check_mark: + any conditions.

release-bot: CI status update for `runtime-1.18-lts` / `release-1.18.1-lts-rc.1`
- unit/integration: PASS
- scheduler-regression-suite: PASS
- reproducible-build: PASS
- sbom-generation: PASS
- artifact-signing: PASS
Details: https://buildkite.redwood.dev/builds/rt-lts-1181-rc1

Sahana Iyer: Build side looks good.
- provenance: attached in buildkite step `provenance.json` (SLSA v1.0 attestation)
- checksums: `sha256sums.txt` uploaded to release staging bucket
- signatures: cosign signatures present for image + `sha256sums.txt`
Verification notes here (internal): https://confluence.redwood.dev/display/ENGINFRA/LTS+artifact+verification#1.18.1-rc1
:white_check_mark:

Marcus Reed: Perf gate summary highlights:
- A100/H100/L4 coverage ran (A10 skipped due to runner quota)
- p50 latency within ±1.5% across canonical workloads
- p95 latency worst case +2.8% on L4 for `mixed-128-2k` (still within threshold of +3%)
- throughput within ±2% everywhere
- no new variance spikes vs 1.18.0 baseline

Notes: there was one flaky run on H100 `long-4k` earlier today; this run is clean.
:white_check_mark: from perf suite.

Jonas Weber: +1 on perf. The +2.8% p95 on L4 is right at the edge but within policy; looks consistent with the batching-heuristic guard we merged (expected tiny hit on small GPUs). No waiver needed.
:white_check_mark:

Hiro Tanaka: Kernel sign-off: reviewed the RC diff vs 1.18.0-lts baseline.
- Autotune defaults are frozen as intended
- KV cache compaction fix is in (PR-23341) + unit repro test passing
- No new kernel flags toggled in this patch
:white_check_mark: OK to ship.

Sofia Ivanova: Scheduler sign-off.
- starvation edge-case fix is included + new regression test in suite
- checked overload/backpressure scenarios from the scheduler suite run; no regressions

One note: release notes should keep the known issue callout for "rare queue depth spike under bursty streaming" w/ workaround (disable streaming on route) until we see 2 weeks clean.
:white_check_mark: for RC.

Allison Grant: Observability looks ready.
- LTS dashboards are already wired for 1.18-lts tags (SLO toolkit PR-912)
- release monitoring checklist in place (latency/error budget + OOM rate)

Condition: please publish the release notes URL before we start any Dedicated rollout so we can link it in incident comms if needed.
:white_check_mark:

Sean Gallagher: SRE sign-off contingent on staged rollout plan:
1) Hosted: internal canary (5%) for 60 min
2) Dedicated pilot accounts only (Northstar/Helio) after canary green
3) Pause 24h before wider Dedicated
Private: available immediately, but "recommended" after 24h if no Sev2+

Connor, if you confirm the above will be in the comms blurb, I'm good.
:white_check_mark: (with conditions)

Elliot Price: Release notes PR 23510 looks good. I’ll add the scheduler known issue note Sofia mentioned + make sure compatibility matrix is updated before publish.
Will post final rendered notes link here once generated.

Dev Patel: Support is ready.
- we’ll route any LTS RC feedback to #eng-releases + backport intake template
- please include the checksums/provenance verification snippet in the customer-facing notes (even if short)
:white_check_mark:

Connor O'Brien: Thanks all.
- SRE staged rollout confirmed (matches runbook)
- Elliot, please drop the final release notes URL when ready; we’ll block publish until it’s live.

Next steps (unless objections in next ~30 min):
- create git tag `runtime-v1.18.1-lts`
- push `runtime:1.18.1-lts` + helm annotation update
- post announcement in #announcements + Support/CS distro

Holding publish until Elliot posts the rendered notes link.

Elliot Price: Rendered notes are up: https://docs.redwood.dev/runtime/lts/1.18.1-lts
Includes: perf summary, upgrade/rollback notes, checksums verification snippet, and known issues section.
:white_check_mark:

Connor O'Brien: Great. Proceeding with publish now.
- tagging + pushing artifacts (ETA ~15 min)
- will start Hosted internal canary immediately after registry tags propagate

If you see anything weird in dashboards, please @ me here.
